text:
Priya Shah: Quick sync — Product asked for a single, copy-paste Terraform blueprint we can hand to cloud partners for marketplace onboarding. Needs to cover: VPC peering, private endpoints, RBAC, and a small demo app + notes on legal/compliance hooks. Target: partner enablement kickoff week of May 12.
Mike Chen: OK. do we have an existing module we can adapt or start fresh?
Priya Shah: We have fragments in infra-kit but they're very vendor-specific. want a small generic module + provider examples (aws/azure/gcp).
Jasper Vogel: I can extract the networking and IAM patterns into a module. Suggest naming: redwood/partner-marketplace-blueprint. keep examples in /examples/{cloud}/marketplace.tf
Ana Lopez: +1. need a clear checklist for listing requirements per marketplace (publisher metadata, image sizing, integration tests). I'll draft the checklist.
Devon R: Who owns publishing pipeline? marketplace-bot usually triggers listings but we need CI to build images and run compliance scan.
Priya Shah: Devon, can you own CI + publish hooks? target minimal: build, vuln-scan, sign artifact, publish to partner staging repo.
Devon R: yep. I'll add a GitHub Actions workflow. sample snippet we can use: 
```
name: publish-marketplace
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: build image
        run: ./scripts/build.sh
      - name: run snyk
        run: snyk test || true
      - name: sign artifact
        run: cosign sign ${{ secrets.IMAGE }}
      - name: publish
        run: ./scripts/publish.sh
```

Jasper Vogel: For Terraform modules we should pick a stable interface: module variables: partner_name, cloud, region, cidr_ranges, enable_private_endpoint (bool), tags (map). Keep outputs minimal: vpc_id, subnet_ids, endpoint_ids, example_service_url.
Priya Shah: Good. Also include a README with step-by-step: 1) fork module 2) update partner metadata 3) run example 4) how to request Dedicated capacity via sales path.
Ana Lopez: I'll add marketplace-specific pages: Azure has ARM artifact requirements and a manifest; AWS requires AMI/Container registry + listing images. I'll call out differences in README.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: upcoming marketplace standards doc v2 posted: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/standards-v2 (public: no)
Mike Chen: Can we add a small e2e smoke test that deploys the demo app and hits /health? That helps partners verify. Keep it ~2 minutes.
Devon R: e2e test can be a simple terraform apply -> wait -> curl -> destroy. I'll wire into GH actions as a conditional step (only for staging).
Priya Shah: Timeline: draft module by Apr 28, internal review Apr 30, demo with 1 partner May 12. Who's OK for these deadlines?
Jasper Vogel: I'm good to deliver the first cut by Apr 28.
Ana Lopez: I can finish the checklists by Apr 29.
Mike Chen: I'll review the networking bits Apr 30.
Devon R: CI + publish hooks by May 5.
Priya Shah: Perfect. Action items: Jasper - module skeleton + examples; Devon - GH workflow + sign/publish scripts; Ana - marketplace checklists and README sections; Mike - review networking and RBAC. I'll schedule a 30m sync for May 1 to catch blockers.
Mike Chen: tiny ask: include tfsec baseline config and example of provider pinning in module to avoid drift.
Jasper Vogel: will do. I'll add `tfsec-ignore` guidance for partners.
Priya Shah: thanks all. I'll post the meeting invite.
marketplace-bot: New doc created: /docs/partner-marketplace-blueprint/draft-v1 (created by Priya Shah)
Ana Lopez: pinging @partners-eng to keep them in the loop when draft lands.
Mike Chen: thanks — will watch the PR. :thumbsup:
